description: The five-channel GOES Imager on GOES-14 (0.65, 3.9, 6.5/6.7, 10.7, 12.0 or 13.3 um). The curves are the operational per-detector, per-scan-side spectral response functions distributed by NOAA OSPO.
facility_description: GOES-8 to GOES-15 were NOAA's third-generation geostationary weather satellites (GOES I-M and N-P series).

links.label: OSPO GOES-8 through GOES-15 Imager Spectral Response Functions

notes: OSPO: 'All of them were provided by ITT (the instruments' manufacturer), except those noted as modified by STAR.' The zip has no README; the IR file-to-channel/detector mapping is inferred as for GOES-13 and checked against each file's wavenumber range. Band names follow SVO's GOES/Imager IDs (VIS_dK, IR<ch>_d<det>s<side>); pivots agree with SVO's archived records to <=0.01 %. DetectorType energy is assumed.
